The main takeaway from our work is that

the VSA has provided the first direct detection of the acoustic peak in the cosmic microwave background power spectrum at small angular scales, and that this detection, combined with other cosmic microwave background experiments, is already starting to provide tight constraints on cosmological parameters, and will continue to do so as more data are gathered.

the combination of all current cosmic microwave background and Hubble Space Telescope data provides the tightest constraints on the cosmological parameters, and is consistent with a flat, low-density universe with a cosmological constant. © 2003 The Authors.
